messages:
Tessa: quick heads-up as I take the quiet evening shift — I'm primary for the next ~3h. leaving notes for the next handover, tiny pager earlier but resolved, still logging the steps here for whoever inherits.
incident-bot: Pager triggered: RED-EMBED-PROD — severity: P3 — 2025-11-02T21:12Z — summary: elevated 5xx rate on embed-service. runbook: https://rwd.io/runbooks/embed-5xx — incident link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/RED-EMBED-PROD-3421
Sam: saw the alert, spun a temporary fallback route to the smaller embed model (fallback-compact). traffic ~10% shifted, latency returned to baseline :thumbsup:
Devon: noted. small coverage gap FYI — I need to drop at 00:45 UTC, can't cover final 1h of your shift. someone ok to take 00:45->02:00?
Marta: I can take the secondary/relay from 00:45->02:00 UTC, will monitor p99 and the embed error-rate.
Tessa: awesome thanks @Marta. quick runbook-oriented checklist for the handoff (copy into your notes):
- confirm no active P1s/P0s via incident-bot / console
- verify fallback route still healthy (console -> routing)
- check kv-cache hit rate for embed prefix (should be >= 85%)
- tail api logs for new 5xx patterns (10m window)
- check autoscaler (HPA) events and recent restarts
- post customer-impact note in OPS ticket if any accounts affected
Akshay: adding concrete commands/snippets to make this fast for whoever's on-call:
```bash
# list embed pods + basic health
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embed-service -o wide
# tail recent errors (10m)
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=embed-service -c api --since=10m | grep -iE "(error|5..|timeout)" | tail -n 200
# check kv-cache hit ratio (grafana/api)
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_hit_ratio%7Bservice%3D%22embed%22%7D" | jq .
# temporary rollback of model-route (if fallback not healthy)
# NOTE: only run if traffic >10% degraded and fallback tested
redwoodctl routes set embed-service --route fallback-compact --percent 30
```
Sam: console quick-links:
- metrics/alerts: https://console.redwood.ai/teams/prod/metrics/embed-service
- routing panel: https://console.redwood.ai/teams/prod/routing
- incident page: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/RED-EMBED-PROD-3421
Tessa: runbook shortcuts (copy/paste):
- embed 5xx playbook: https://rwd.io/runbooks/embed-5xx
- fallback routing guide: https://rwd.io/runbooks/fallback-routing
- HPA / autoscaler restart: https://rwd.io/runbooks/hpa-restart
Devon: customer impact note — small set of customers saw degraded embeddings: acct-342, acct-998. I opened OPS ticket OPS-8897 and added a short description + timeline. severity currently P3, no data exfil suspected.
Marta: for the handover I'll do these final checks before I take primary:
- confirm embed 5xx rate stable <0.5% over 10m
- verify fallback route percent and metrics match
- ensure no pending restarts in the last 15m
I'll paste the last command outputs into the handover comment.
Tessa: escalation path reminders (leave in thread):
- if 5xx spikes back to >2% persist for >15m -> escalate to oncall-sev and page @platform-leads
- if customer data concerns -> page @security immediately and follow the security runbook
- if autoscaler thrash observed -> open rapid escalationsrag and ping @infra-oncall
Akshay: small proactive fixes that often help (safe to run):
1) clear embed-processing backlog if queue length > 1000 (confirm with redis-cli before clearing)
2) bump fallback to 30% for 10m to validate stability
3) restart one replica (not all) if it's flapping and observe
Marta: taking notes — I'll add the handover snapshot at 00:40 UTC including the outputs of the commands above. if anyone is handed off earlier ping me in thread, I'll join mutely.
Tessa: final — copy-paste handover template for convenience:
- primary: Tessa (until 00:45 UTC)
- secondary: Marta (00:45->02:00 UTC)
- open incidents: RED-EMBED-PROD (P3) — link https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/RED-EMBED-PROD-3421
- last mitigation actions: fallback route -> fallback-compact (10%), OPS ticket OPS-8897 created
- next checks for incoming oncall: metrics p99, 5xx, kv-cache ratio, HPA events, pods health (use snippets above)
Devon: thanks all — good template. I'll be offline after 00:45 but will check mentions if something escalates.
Tessa: thanks team, leaving thread open for the handover snapshot. :white_check_mark:
